svg.title: Computed bifurcation diagram of the discrete FitzHugh-Nagumo map with theta = 0.51, alpha = 0.01, beta = 0.02, gamma = 0.8, plotting u against A from 3 to 7: fixed points at u = 0 and u = 1 undergo period-doubling cascades starting near A = 3.92 and A = 4.08, turn into chaotic bands with periodic windows, and the two chaotic regions merge near A = 6.5.
